source_state: uncommitted implementation hashed in input manifest; commit only after offline tests

criterion.scope: Previously inspected deterministic v89 unloaded development data; criteria fixed before this revision's fitting. Not a fresh confirmatory test or a controller safety guarantee.

consumer.interpretation: 0.2 s is a frame opportunity, not a guaranteed fix. 3.0 s is the strict-greater-than relook trigger; 3.2 s is a neighbouring delay/tick stress horizon, not a guaranteed upper bound on a successful fix. Loaded travel-based looks and manipulation are out of scope.
consumer.comparison: Existing per-step white process covariance, propagated with heading coupling from an ideal zero-error pose fix. Persistent scale_std and scale_walk covariance is additionally reported but cannot rescue acceptance; actual posterior scale uncertainty is unknown. No measurement covariance, map prior, reset or roughening is credited.

split.fit_mean_and_noise: all six complete signed step+stop segments per axis
split.validation: one continuous PRBS+stop segment per axis
split.windows: every 0.05 s start whose complete horizon is inside its segment, including zero-motion, onset, reversal and stop windows; never bridge fit/validation boundaries
split.initial_state: Observed start pose represents an ideal visual fix; motor/velocity state is warmed by issued commands from the beginning of the full recording, never by measured velocity or future poses. End pose is evaluation-only.

criterion.fit_objective: unweighted concatenation of driven-axis k-step position errors over all listed horizons on steps only; no whole-trajectory NRMSE gate

noise.method: zero-mean nonnegative Gaussian quasi-MLE on step window residuals, without centering away bias
noise.variance: q_j * horizon_s + alpha_j_translation * predicted_absolute_travel_m^2; turn terms alpha2/alpha4 are null because all turn commands are zero
noise.reference_mapping: alpha1=along variance per translation squared, alpha3=yaw variance per translation squared; alpha_lateral is a mecanum cross-axis extension. alpha2/alpha4 multiply turn travel squared and are unidentifiable. This is a finite-horizon adaptation, not a claim of implementing the complete six-alpha velocity sampler.

acceptance.note: All three residual components must pass separately. These fixed engineering tolerances surround Gaussian 68.27/95.45 percent coverage and NEES/dimension=1; overlapping deterministic windows are not independent samples, so no chi-square confidence or population coverage claim is made. Reject excessive coverage as well as undercoverage; noise inflation cannot substitute for a mean model.

criterion.rotation: No turn command in v89; no rotation mean, alpha2 or alpha4 can be adopted. v87 two single-amplitude steps do not replace turn validation.
criterion.consumer_reason: Current final-v3 loader accepts schema v1 + MEASURED_SIM only. New finite-horizon motion-dependent covariance is not the existing noise_rel/noise_abs rule. No controllers are modified.

audit.frame: integrated midpoint-yaw body-frame increments; eval_only targets
audit.initial_state: zero at each complete step+coast and PRBS sequence; no measured velocity

consumer_note: P03 uses the hash-frozen M1 predict_to, whose unloaded mean/noise law matches the current localizer. Robust stuck is disabled in selected_config_v3. VIS4 exact integration is opt-in, not the scored P03 default.

numerical_model.contact_scope: smooth effective force; not an exact MuJoCo contact solver
